answer: Because the island index resolves every citation against the tundra checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the nebula audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 110 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 110 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 1203 identities would post 4946 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
